dedupe_keys.name: evaluating government s policies on promoting smart metering diffusion in retail electricity markets

description: Tao Zhang published this agent-based market game to examine UK smart-meter promotion policy during 2008 to 2010. The model separates the policy into four options and compares their effects on adoption dynamics in the retail electricity market. Coverage is the stated UK policy context; the metadata does not provide a fixed spatial resolution, a current market calibration or a transferable forecasting period. It supports simulation of policy effects on the diffusion of electricity metering infrastructure. The model addresses market adoption and does not simulate distribution-network electrical flows. Its historical policy setting limits direct interpretation as an assessment of present UK metering arrangements. Release 1.0.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists NetLogo. The release licence is GPL-2.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
